description: This file defines a React functional component 'OrganizationInfoView' that manages and displays information about an organization, including overview, members, and settings. It includes state management, API calls for fetching and updating data, and UI elements for user interaction.

methods.name: fetchOrgInfo
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches organization information from the backend API and updates state. Called on component mount and when 'organizationId' or 'accessToken' change.

methods.name: handleMemberAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new member to the organization by calling the API and updating the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: handleMemberUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing organization member via API and refreshes data.

methods.name: handleMemberDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting an organization member via API and updates the UI.

methods.name: handleOrgUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating organization settings, including name, models, budget, rate limits, and permissions, via API.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard, with UI feedback for success.
